items.a: Winter Camp 2027 is run by Kid's Happy Club for two groups: Kids, who are under 10 years old, and Youth, who are 10 to 18 years old. Age is counted on the first day of each group's camp.
The Youth camp (10 to 18) is from 4 to 6 January 2027. The Kids camp (under 10) is from 11 to 13 January 2027.
At Snow View Residency, Jogiwara Road, McLeodganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh, India, 176219.
The registration fee is ₹500 per child.

Pay ₹500 by UPI during registration, using the QR code, the UPI ID achuisr1985.27-1@okhdfcbank or the phone number 8219012669. The payee name is Achui Sareo. You then upload a screenshot of the payment.
Snacks and a hot lunch are provided every day, along with games, craft, storytelling, music time and a picnic on day 3. There is one staff member for every seven children.
Press Register now on this website, choose Kids or Youth, fill in the form, sign it, pay ₹500 by UPI and upload the payment screenshot. A seat is given only when the form is sent with the screenshot.

items.q: What happens when seats are full?
items.a: Each group has 30 seats, given first come, first served. When a group is full, registration for it closes; please contact +91-8219012669.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.metaTitle: Privacy notice · Winter Camp 2027 · Kid's Happy Club
privacy.metaDescription: How Kid's Happy Club collects, uses, stores and deletes the information given when registering a child for Winter Camp 2027.

p: Winter Camp 2027 is organised by Kid's Happy Club and held at Snow View Residency, Jogiwara Road, McLeodganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh, India, 176219. To ask anything about this notice, call +91-8219012669.

When you register a child we collect: the child's name and date of birth; the group (Kids or Youth); the parent's or guardian's name; your address; emergency contact numbers; any medical conditions, dietary requirements or allergies you tell us about; your answer on medical emergency consent; your signature and the date of signing; a screenshot of your UPI payment and, if you give it, the transaction reference; the language you used; and the time the form was sent.

We use this information only to run the camp: to keep a seat for your child, to confirm your payment, to keep your child safe, to cater for health and dietary needs, and to contact you in an emergency.
The form must be completed by a parent or guardian. By ticking the agreement box and signing, you consent to us using this information for the camp.

Only the camp organisers. The information is kept in a private Google Sheet and private Google Drive folders that are shared with named organisers only. We do not sell it, publish it or share it with advertisers. It may be shared with medical staff if your child needs treatment.
We keep registration details, signatures and payment screenshots until the camp accounts are settled, and delete them within 90 days of the end of the camp.

sections.h: What this website stores on your device
p: This website uses no cookies, advertising or tracking. It remembers only your language and sound settings in your browser. What you type in the form is held in the page until it is sent and is not saved on your device.
The gallery shows photos and videos from earlier camps, published with consent. To have a photo or video of your child removed, call +91-8219012669.
You can ask to see, correct or delete your child's information at any time by calling +91-8219012669.
